```{r}
#| label: setup
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

hex_path <- "../outputs/hex/faa_hex_scores.geojson"
has_hex <- file.exists(hex_path)

wfe_cat_levels <- c("Very Low", "Low", "Moderate", "High", "Very High")
wfe_cat_colors <- c(
  "Very Low" = "#f7fcf5",
  "Low" = "#c7e9c0",
  "Moderate" = "#74c476",
  "High" = "#238b45",
  "Very High" = "#00441b"
)
```

These layers are **context**: they help interpret why a hex got an action. They do **not** replace the [Actions](index.qmd) map. Switch layers with the control (top-right); the legend updates with the active layer.

PAD is shown for orientation only — it does not pick actions or Goldilocks scores. See [Methods](methods.qmd).

```{r}
#| label: context-map
#| fig-height: 9
if (!has_hex) {
  cat(
    "**No hex output yet.** Run the Pro pipeline through `05_export_hex_geojson.py`, ",
    "commit `outputs/hex/faa_hex_scores.geojson`, then re-render.\n"
  )
} else {
  hex <- st_read(hex_path, quiet = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      WFE_CAT = factor(
        as.character(WFE_CAT),
        levels = wfe_cat_levels
      ),
      MEAN = as.numeric(MEAN),
      WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN = as.numeric(WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN),
      PADUS_FRAC = as.numeric(PADUS_FRAC),
      FDIST_FUEL_DELTA = as.numeric(FDIST_FUEL_DELTA)
    )

  wfe_pal <- colorNumeric(
    palette = c("#ffffcc", "#fd8d3c", "#800026"),
    domain = range(hex$MEAN, na.rm = TRUE),
    na.color = "#cccccc"
  )
  wfe_cat_pal <- colorFactor(
    palette = unname(wfe_cat_colors[wfe_cat_levels]),
    domain = wfe_cat_levels,
    levels = wfe_cat_levels,
    ordered = TRUE,
    na.color = "#cccccc"
  )
  people_pal <- colorNumeric(
    palette = c("#f7f4f9", "#d4b9da", "#980043"),
    domain = range(hex$WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN, na.rm = TRUE),
    na.color = "#cccccc"
  )
  pad_pal <- colorNumeric(
    palette = c("#f7fbff", "#6baed6", "#08306b"),
    domain = c(0, 1),
    na.color = "#cccccc"
  )
  # Diverging: fuel remove (-) → neutral → fuel add (+)
  fdist_lim <- max(0.25, max(abs(hex$FDIST_FUEL_DELTA), na.rm = TRUE))
  fdist_pal <- colorNumeric(
    palette = c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"),
    domain = c(-fdist_lim, fdist_lim),
    na.color = "#cccccc"
  )

  # Precompute popup text (avoid if/&& on whole columns inside leaflet formulas)
  evt_bit <- if ("EVT_NAME" %in% names(hex)) {
    ifelse(
      !is.na(hex$EVT_NAME) & hex$EVT_NAME != "",
      paste0("Majority EVT: ", hex$EVT_NAME, "<br/>"),
      ""
    )
  } else {
    rep("", nrow(hex))
  }
  pine_bit <- if ("PINE_HEX" %in% names(hex)) {
    paste0("Pine/barrens flag: ", hex$PINE_HEX, "<br/>")
  } else {
    rep("", nrow(hex))
  }
  peat_bit <- if ("PEAT_HEX" %in% names(hex)) {
    paste0("Peat flag: ", hex$PEAT_HEX)
  } else {
    rep("", nrow(hex))
  }

  hex <- hex |>
    mutate(
      popup_html = paste0(
        "<b>", GRID_ID, "</b><br/>",
        "WFE mean: ", round(MEAN, 3),
        " (", as.character(WFE_CAT), ")<br/>",
        "People (HU Risk): ", round(WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN, 1), "<br/>",
        "PAD frac: ", round(PADUS_FRAC, 2), "<br/>",
        "FDist fuel delta: ", round(FDIST_FUEL_DELTA, 3), "<br/>",
        evt_bit,
        pine_bit,
        peat_bit
      )
    )

  bb <- st_bbox(hex)
  pad_x <- (bb[["xmax"]] - bb[["xmin"]]) * 0.01
  pad_y <- (bb[["ymax"]] - bb[["ymin"]]) * 0.01
  west <- bb[["xmin"]] - pad_x
  south <- bb[["ymin"]] - pad_y
  east <- bb[["xmax"]] + pad_x
  north <- bb[["ymax"]] + pad_y

  base_groups <- c(
    "Wildfire exposure (mean)",
    "WFE category",
    "People (HU Risk)",
    "PAD (GAP 1–3 frac)",
    "Recent fuel change (FDist)"
  )

  m <- leaflet(
    height = "85vh",
    width = "100%",
    options = leafletOptions(zoomSnap = 0.25, zoomDelta = 0.5)
  ) |>
    addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
    fitBounds(west, south, east, north) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = hex,
      fillColor = ~ wfe_pal(MEAN),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#333333",
      weight = 0.2,
      opacity = 0.4,
      group = "Wildfire exposure (mean)",
      popup = ~ popup_html
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = hex,
      fillColor = ~ unname(wfe_cat_colors[as.character(WFE_CAT)]),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#333333",
      weight = 0.2,
      opacity = 0.4,
      group = "WFE category",
      popup = ~ popup_html
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = hex,
      fillColor = ~ people_pal(WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#333333",
      weight = 0.2,
      opacity = 0.4,
      group = "People (HU Risk)",
      popup = ~ popup_html
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = hex,
      fillColor = ~ pad_pal(PADUS_FRAC),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#333333",
      weight = 0.2,
      opacity = 0.4,
      group = "PAD (GAP 1–3 frac)",
      popup = ~ popup_html
    ) |>
    addPolygons(
      data = hex,
      fillColor = ~ fdist_pal(FDIST_FUEL_DELTA),
      fillOpacity = 0.75,
      color = "#333333",
      weight = 0.2,
      opacity = 0.4,
      group = "Recent fuel change (FDist)",
      popup = ~ popup_html
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = wfe_pal,
      values = hex$MEAN,
      title = "WFE mean",
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = "Wildfire exposure (mean)"
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      colors = unname(wfe_cat_colors[wfe_cat_levels]),
      labels = wfe_cat_levels,
      title = "WFE category",
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = "WFE category"
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = people_pal,
      values = hex$WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN,
      title = "HU Risk",
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = "People (HU Risk)"
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = pad_pal,
      values = c(0, 1),
      title = "PAD frac",
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = "PAD (GAP 1–3 frac)"
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = fdist_pal,
      values = c(-fdist_lim, fdist_lim),
      title = "Fuel delta (− remove / + add)",
      opacity = 0.9,
      group = "Recent fuel change (FDist)"
    ) |>
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = base_groups,
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    ) |>
    htmlwidgets::onRender(sprintf(
      "
      function(el, x) {
        var map = this;
        var bounds = [[%f, %f], [%f, %f]];
        var titleMap = {
          'Wildfire exposure (mean)': 'WFE mean',
          'WFE category': 'WFE category',
          'People (HU Risk)': 'HU Risk',
          'PAD (GAP 1–3 frac)': 'PAD frac',
          'Recent fuel change (FDist)': 'Fuel delta'
        };
        function legendTitle(leg) {
          var s = leg.querySelector('strong');
          return s ? s.textContent.trim() : '';
        }
        function syncLegends() {
          var legends = el.querySelectorAll('.legend');
          var inputs = el.querySelectorAll('.leaflet-control-layers-base input');
          var active = null;
          inputs.forEach(function(inp) {
            if (inp.checked) active = inp.parentElement.textContent.trim();
          });
          var want = titleMap[active] || '';
          legends.forEach(function(leg) {
            var title = legendTitle(leg);
            leg.style.display = (want && title.indexOf(want) === 0) ? 'block' : 'none';
          });
        }
        function fitAOI() {
          map.invalidateSize(false);
          map.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [10, 10], animate: false });
        }
        map.on('baselayerchange', syncLegends);
        setTimeout(syncLegends, 50);
        var nFit = 0;
        function fitOnce() { fitAOI(); nFit += 1; }
        fitOnce();
        setTimeout(fitOnce, 150);
        setTimeout(fitOnce, 500);
        setTimeout(fitOnce, 1200);
        if (window.ResizeObserver) {
          var ro = new ResizeObserver(function() {
            if (nFit < 8) fitOnce(); else ro.disconnect();
          });
          ro.observe(el);
        }
      }
      ",
      south, west, north, east
    ))

  m
}
```
